plotSections.title: Planning the Route to The Reach
bullets: The party discussed returning to Langdale but decided their more immediate goal is tracking down the lich who previously had a hideout or cave in The Reach.
Sylan suggested investigating the lich's old hideout for clues; otherwise, the party may have to return to Nyx and interrogate hobgoblins to learn where the lich is hiding.

The party considered using Walker's portal ability to transport their boat, but the DM clarified that the Gate spell creates a 5-to-20-foot-diameter opening, so it cannot accommodate their boat unless the vessel can fit through a 20-foot opening.
The party has multiple ways to reach The Reach, including their boat and a captain who regularly travels between realms. Sylan favored whichever option gets them to the lich most quickly.
The party noted that their boat has food and water supplies and can potentially resupply at a centrally located port city in The Reach.

plotSections.title: The Party's Ship and Crew
bullets: The party confirmed that their four surviving-and-revived crew members are Abel, Garrett, Bill, and Fritz.
Abel is the helmsman and Garrett is the gunner. Fritz and Bill's exact roles are not currently remembered, although one is believed to be a greenhorn.
Dana clarified that some crew members had previously died but were revived, with Dana having invested significant effort and spells into keeping them alive.
Walker raised another obligation before departing: he needs to take Elrus somewhere.
